newsitem.title: USA: BellSouth says spent $205 mln on 39 licenses.
newsitem.headline: BellSouth says spent $205 mln on 39 licenses.

text.p: BellSouth Corp Tuesday said it spent $205 million as the higher bidder during five months of government auctions, securing 39 licenses to provide wireless telephone services in 37 Southeast markets.

The company said that the high bid for the Personal Communications Services in the Federal Communication Commision's Basic Trading Area 10 megahertz auction has earned them access to areas where 11.8 million people live.

"These new licenses will now serve to broaden our reach and service area for customers, and soon all customers in our nine-state region will be able to use BellSouth wireless telephone service," Earle Mauldin, president of BellSouth Enterprises, said in a statement.

The 39 new licenses effectively fill in BellSouth's wireless telephone coverage throughout the company's nine-state region that includes Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Kentucky, Mississippi, North Carolina, South Carolina and Tennessee, the company said.
